## Chronological Employment History (Exact `MM/YYYY – MM/YYYY` CV Alignment)

1. **John Deere** (Pune, India) — **AI Architect & Technical Lead (official title: Senior Data Scientist)** · **`01/2023 – 10/2026`**
   - Owned architecture, AWS platform (Terraform, GitHub Actions), and delivery for **23+ AI initiatives** across Customer & Product Support leading a **12+ member team** — FY26 impact: **750K+ automated requests**, **42K+ hours saved**.
   - Built **StoneAge**, an AI writing copilot inside the engineering system of record (LangGraph agents, OpenSearch hybrid search, multi-model routing across GPT-5, GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, React, FastAPI, Okta).
   - Turned around a ~30%-accurate single-model GenAI product to **~70% accuracy** via GPT-4o Vision diagram extraction, product-family routing, and deterministic rule checks (46 active users).
   - Designed a **6-agent authoring workflow** backed by a **Neo4j knowledge graph** with mandatory source citations, and built **AIFlow** (**255** automated quality checks blocking regressions in CI + zero-latency live drift, accuracy, cost, and latency monitoring).
   - Repaired ~171K broken links (~8,600 hours saved), generated ~110K standards-compliant documents (100% Large Tractor adoption), automated ~25% of support tickets end-to-end (~83% accuracy, ~4,700 hours saved), sat on the **AI Governance Council** (NIST AI RMF / EU AI Act), and led 3 years of digital transformation enabling **300+ employees**.
2. **Persistent Systems** (Pune, India) — **Engineering Lead — Machine Learning** · **`01/2021 – 01/2023`**
   - Delivered end-to-end client ML projects, static/dynamic deployment, MLOps, and secure database integrations across PIAM access recommendation, iDataCleanse identity deduplication, face recognition, VMS recommendation, VectorFlow POD, and Vertina NLP; mentored engineers across the portfolio.
3. **Vertiv** (Hyderabad, India) — **Data Scientist** · **`03/2020 – 01/2021`**
   - Built ML/DL models on production data for compliance analytics and Customer 360, pushing filtering and aggregation down to AWS Athena and delivering executive Tableau dashboards.
4. **Soham Global** (India) — **Software Engineer — Machine Learning** · **`03/2016 – 02/2020`**
   - Built account-balance and price-tag forecasting with leakage-safe time-based validation, market-basket analysis, recommendation, and inventory tracking for finance and e-commerce clients.
5. **GlaxoSmithKline (GSK)** (Brentford, United Kingdom) — **HANA Lead Consultant — Data Platform & Predictive Analytics** · **`02/2014 – 02/2016`**
   - Built in-database machine learning models (regression, random forest, SVM, clustering, ARIMA / Holt-Winters forecasting, churn scoring) inside SAP HANA (PAL, APL, R); reduced MRP and financial consolidation batch runs from hours to minutes.
6. **Earlier Enterprise Data & Analytics Consulting (`2004 – 2014` — India, Malaysia, Singapore, UK, US):**
   - **GSK India & HCL Axon UK** — HANA Consultant (`2012 – 2014`): turned finance KPIs into data models and specifications with business users.
   - **PETRONAS Energy Trading & Deloitte, Kuala Lumpur** — HANA / BPC Architect (`2011 – 2012`): proof of concept cut a data load from **48 hours to 12 minutes** and won an internal rollout.
   - **DHL, Symantec & Khaga, Malaysia · Singapore** — BPC / BusinessObjects Consultant (`2008 – 2011`): financial consolidation and billing data warehouse.
   - **Lenovo, SEAL InfoTech & High Industries, Chennai · United States** — BW / BI Consultant (`2004 – 2008`): CRM sales analytics data models.

## Curated Open-Source Portfolio (`17` Public Repositories — `10/10` CV Selected Projects `HTTP 200`)

1. **[CompanyOS (`company-os`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/company-os)** — 7 executive AI agents plan, assign, and track a company's work from one config file — Kanban, live logs, KPI engine (Python).
2. **[Adaptive AI Tutor (`adaptive-ai-tutor`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/adaptive-ai-tutor)** — Agentic learning platform with 12 GPT-4o agents for curriculum, tutoring, and assessment (Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma).
3. **[LLM Knowledge Base (`llm-knowledge-base`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/llm-knowledge-base)** — Turns raw sources into an LLM-maintained wiki with full-text search and Q&A (FastAPI, SQLite FTS5).
4. **[LangGraph Newsroom (`langgraph-newsroom`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/langgraph-newsroom)** — 3-stage news production pipeline with human approval gates, checkpointing, and error recovery (LangGraph).
5. **[AegisRuntime (`aegis-runtime`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/aegis-runtime)** — Policy and audit layer for AI-agent tool calls — deny-by-default policy language, saga rollback, compaction attribution, and signed tamper-evident audit log.
6. **[PrismGate (`prism-gate`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/prism-gate)** — OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway — adaptive concurrency, per-tenant rate limits, cost-aware model cascade, and drift detection (FastAPI).
7. **[Vecta (`vecta`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/vecta)** — From-scratch vector search engine — HNSW, IVF-PQ, and hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval with C++20 kernels (`0.999` recall@10).
8. **[Syntara (`syntara`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/syntara)** — Grammar-constrained decoding — compiles JSON Schema / regex into token masks so LLM output is valid by construction (`20/20` schema-valid).
9. **[Enterprise Help-Desk RAG & Guardrails System (`enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-helpdesk-rag-guardrails)** — RAG help-desk assistant with similarity thresholds, code-enforced refusal when retrieval confidence is low, and automated acceptance tests.
10. **[Enterprise ERP OData MCP Server (`enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server`)](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-erp-odata-mcp-server)** — MCP server enabling AI agents to query ERP systems over OData APIs with schema validation and tool-calling guardrails.
11. **[governed-member-services-agent](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/governed-member-services-agent)** — Multi-tenant regulated member-services workflow with deterministic tool authorization, grounded citations, and a 40-case evaluation gate.
12. **[verispec-sdd](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/verispec-sdd)** — Executable `SPEC.md` state-machine compiler with C++20 CSR reachability/deadlock/livelock verification and property-test synthesis.
13. **[skillbench](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/skillbench)** — Static information-flow taint analyzer and C++20 Aho-Corasick scanner for `SKILL.md` bundles and MCP schemas.
14. **[weavegraph](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/weavegraph)** — Dependency-aware `git worktree` scheduler using C++20 Tarjan SCC condensation and 3-way AST semantic merge verification.
15. **[tracegit](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/tracegit)** — Content-addressed version control for AI agent execution trajectories with C++20 edit-distance diffing and bisection.
16. **[calibra](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/calibra)** — Statistical LLM evaluation library (paired bootstrap, exact McNemar, Bradley-Terry CI, 2PL IRT, MinHash-LSH contamination checks).
17. **[enterprise-ai-field-guides](https://github.com/nagarjunak-pixel/enterprise-ai-field-guides)** — 15 open-access practitioner PDF field guides and architecture monographs (`https://nagarjunak-pixel.github.io/handbooks.html`).
